text: This report is filed regarding suspicious activity in the account of Tariq Nawaz (CNIC 498951-5556098-9), a student with a declared monthly income of PKR 25,000. Between April 2 and April 10, 2026, the account received 17 inbound transfers totaling approximately PKR 1,009,000 from 15 distinct counterparties across multiple banks, including Nadia Shah, Adeel Aslam, and Zeeshan Rehman. This volume is significantly inconsistent with the customer's profile and declared income. The activity exhibits classic money mule characteristics: funds were rapidly swept out of the account via three large transfers to a QuickPay wallet (ending in 0932) and one ATM withdrawal in Islamabad. Specifically, PKR 231,000 was transferred to the wallet on April 5, PKR 233,000 was withdrawn in cash on April 6, and further transfers of PKR 277,000 and PKR 134,000 were made to the same wallet on April 10. Notably, two sender banks have issued fraud recall requests citing scam complaints, indicating the inbound funds are likely proceeds of fraud. The rapid movement of funds, the high number of unrelated senders, and the immediate offloading of value to digital wallets and cash strongly suggest the account is being used to layer illicit funds.
